evidence.observation: 2.99 Torr at start of growth, matching the ramp baseline of about 2.95–3.00 Torr
Rose steadily to 3.276 Torr (+0.29 Torr in 480 s) and is still climbing
Flow steady at about 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by the flow
749.4 °C, on the 750 °C setpoint after an initial overshoot to 760.7 °C
Sensor not installed, so the atmosphere cannot be checked for air coming in

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, a leak-up/rate-of-rise test with the flow stopped, or a check of the exhaust line and pump would separate a seal leak (air coming in) from an exhaust blockage.
